preconditions.description: The input integers n and k satisfy the given bounds.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly one line containing the array.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and sum(int(x) for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) == n)
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the sum of the output array elements equals n.
If the answer is YES, the output array has exactly k elements.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(int(x) > 0 for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, every element in the output array is strictly positive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and all(1 < int(b) <= 2 * int(a) for a, b in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1].split(), stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[1:])))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, for every adjacent pair (a_i, a_{i+1}), the condition a_i < a_{i+1} <= 2*a_i holds.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.splitlines()[0] == 'YES' and any(all(1 < int(b) <= 2 * int(a) for a, b in zip(vals, vals[1:])) and sum(vals) == n and all(v > 0 for v in vals) for vals in [list(map(int, stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, a valid sequence exists satisfying all constraints.
If the answer is YES, n is at least the minimum possible sum for k days (which is the sum of the sequence 1, 2, 4, ..., 2^(k-1)).
